name: Alexander Hernandez
summary: A powerful pot-shotting counter striker who rebuilt his career after confidence problems: four straight wins (knockouts of Chase Hooper and Diego Ferreira) until Rafa Garcia's bull-headed pressure beat him in April.

how_they_fight.Striking: Powerful, well-timed shots from range; feels in control when opponents don't pressure.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Has historically folded under sustained pressure, but fixed much of that.

keys_to_beat: Walk him down and make him fight off the back foot
